m1.feature_observations_semantics: Metadata records, not reusable captured tensors

eva_window.population: Archived Exploratory 8 scenes/96 frames/576 camera observations
eva_window.unit: historical camera observation; complete legal source windows=0
eva_window.reason: No complete natural source windows. Do not rerun contextual window approximations.

temporal_full_head_or_attention.reason: Current query, current visual features, pose/time-dependent key positions, and updated FIFO memory change the computation closure. Native temporal memory is already part of the baseline.

temporal_value_projection.status: Candidate only; No-Go on measured net cost
temporal_value_projection.reason: Only Wv(value) has a row-local closure; its source equality, gather and concatenation cost is measured. No Q/K/attention/head skipped.

cross_frame_prefix_kv.status: Candidate only; No-Go on measured net cost
cross_frame_prefix_kv.reason: True matches of native historical expanded inputs measured. cross_frame=True alone is not a hit. Input equality does not certify shape-dependent FP16 KV/logits or original sampling distribution.

task_state_replacement.reason: Partial M1 history is not complete planning/scene evidence; physical validity cannot replace full multimodal input.

funnel_semantics: eligible=audited population; attempted=inspected history; admitted=authorized execution; actually_skipped=real execution. Observation-only rejection/fallback is not a failed task.
